# version set

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:versionSet`](gmeow-versionSet.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/versionSet>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The version set / lineage to which this membership belongs. Functional per relator: one set per [`VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md) -> [`gmeow:VersionSet`](../classes/gmeow-VersionSet.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:versionSet`](gmeow-versionSet.md) from [`gmeow:VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md) to [`gmeow:VersionSet`](../classes/gmeow-VersionSet.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Example Snippets

These snippets are generated from canonical slice examples and trimmed to the Turtle blocks where this term appears.

### Release Channels

- **Source:** [`slices/core/versions/examples/release-channels.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/versions/examples/release-channels.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-versions-examples-release-channels)#example-slices-core-versions-examples-release-channels

```turtle
# --- The membership claim: 1.0.0 is the canonical, major release in the stable
#     channel, as asserted by the maintainer.
ex:canonicalMembership a gmeow:VersionMembership ;
    gmeow:versionMember       ex:release100 ;
    gmeow:versionSet          ex:stableChannel ;
    gmeow:versionRole         gmeow:roleCanonical ;
    gmeow:versionScale        gmeow:scaleMajor ;
    gmeow:membershipAuthority ex:maintainer ;
    gmeow:vantage             ex:maintainer ;
    gmeow:membershipInterval  ex:canonicalPeriod .

# --- A LATER claim, not an overwrite: the same release is now deprecated. The
#     two memberships coexist; their gmeow:membershipIntervals make the order
#     machine-readable — canonical until 2026-06-01, deprecated from then on (P10).
ex:deprecatedMembership a gmeow:VersionMembership ;
    gmeow:versionMember       ex:release100 ;
    gmeow:versionSet          ex:stableChannel ;
    gmeow:versionRole         gmeow:roleDeprecated ;
    gmeow:membershipAuthority ex:maintainer ;
    gmeow:vantage             ex:maintainer ;
    gmeow:membershipInterval  ex:deprecatedPeriod .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md), [`gmeow:VersionSet`](../classes/gmeow-VersionSet.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the one lineage a [`VersionMembership`](../classes/gmeow-VersionMembership.md) places its member into — the concept-level family the version belongs to.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at the concrete artifact (that is [`gmeow:versionMember`](gmeow-versionMember.md)) and avoid more than one set per relator; it is functional.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`versionSet`](gmeow-versionSet.md), an existing [`gmeow:VersionSet`](../classes/gmeow-VersionSet.md) individual, alongside the relator's [`gmeow:versionMember`](gmeow-versionMember.md).

- ex:m1 [`gmeow:versionSet`](gmeow-versionSet.md) ex:gmeowLineage.
